events.context: A truly special holiday experience! Based on witty and humorous scenarios (stories and modern fairy tales, sometimes including songs and music), and incorporating the children's spontaneouseas, we rehearse a play with great enthusiasm. We also practice speaking loudly and clearly, as well as stage presence. At the end, the children perform the play for their parents and relatives.

events.name: KINDERTHEATERKURS IN DEN SOMMERFERIEN
events.context: HOLIDAY FUN. During the holidays, the boards that mean the world are climbed! Through playing together with other children, we learn the fundamentals of acting. We rehearse a play in a fun and welcoming atmosphere. Through acting, dancing, and singing, the children learn to spark enthusiasm and, at the end of the week, present their own play in front of parents and friends.

events.name: Familienführung - Der Hafen für Kinder
events.context: Why are the merchants' houses built in the water? What is stored in the warehouses of the Speicherstadt? We answer these and many other questions about the port on our varied city tour, starting at the historic Deichstraße and ending at the Landungsbrücken piers on the Elbe River. Along the way, we'll see the Speicherstadt warehouse district, HafenCity, and the Elbphilharmonie concert hall, and visit the Old Elbe Tunnel. We'll illustrate the diverse world of the port with pictures, spices, and stories.

events.name: GraviTrax-Bau-Spaß für Kinder
events.context: Bahn frei für kleine Tüftler! Bei unserer Gravitrax Veranstaltung können Kinder spielerisch in die Welt der Schwerkraft und Bewegung eintauchen. Mit den beliebten Kugelbahnelementen von GraviTrax wird gebaut, getestet und getüftelt – ob steile Kurven, flinke Beschleuniger oder spannende Tunnel: Der Fantasie sind keine Grenzen gesetzt!
